mapper.select: SELECT A.ID AS ALERT_ID ,A.USER_ID ,A.STOCK_ID ,S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME ,A.CONDITION ,A.TARGET_PRICE ,U.EMAIL ,U.NICKNAME FROM T_PRICE_ALERT A JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = A.STOCK_ID JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = A.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND U.DEL_DAY IS NULL ORDER BY A.ID
